objective: Independently reproduce every baseline decision input and fee source, capture result, terminal label, and Up/Down outcome-token role before the sealed forward scorer can classify a row as eligible.

discovery.existing_contract: Baseline eligibility used a frozen capture identity plus serialized evaluation_result=low_edge, zone=primary, and fee-adjusted edge at least 0.07.
discovery.gap: The scorer did not independently reproduce zone, volatility flooring, fair value, fee-adjusted edge, entry-fee provenance, or the capture evaluation result. The opportunity report also serialized signal-tape BTC inputs but not the exact spot/open pair used when the separate fair-value anchor tape was active. Resolution manifests already carried authoritative Up/Down outcome-token roles, but the scorer ignored them and only required two distinct stable token IDs.
discovery.risk: A stale, corrupted, or miswired precomputed decision could enter the baseline and selected populations while remaining internally plausible enough to pass the prior source-identity checks, a self-consistent zero-fee report could inflate edge and PnL, a direction could be scored against the wrong outcome book, or a corrupted terminal label could define wins and losses.

frozen_strategy_integrity.block_membership_reason: The fixed 750-condition collection target can overshoot at the final sealed segment. Before any score, block membership is now the first 750 settlement-aligned conditions by open time and condition ID, so batch overshoot cannot enlarge the analyzed sample.

reproduced_values: decision_volatility from observed_volatility and the frozen 0.30 floor
zone and minutes_remaining from the settlement-aligned market open and decision timestamp
directional fair_value from the exact causal fair-value spot/open pair, volatility, remaining time, and fixed 0.05 rate
market_price from the direction-specific executable ask
entry_fee_rate from fee-enabled status, explicit market taker rate, category schedule, and the frozen 0.07 fallback in the same precedence order as the engine
an exact 300-second resolution window from open_ts_s, close_ts_s, and window_seconds before deriving zone or remaining time
fixed block membership as the first 750 settlement-aligned conditions ordered by open_ts_s and condition_id after all supplied sources pass integrity validation
gross_edge, entry_fee_per_share, fee-adjusted edge, and yes_no_vig
capture evaluation result after the frozen cutoff, reversion, confidence, z-score, dead-zone, price, minimum-EV, edge-cap, and impossible-final-edge gates
chosen and opposite token IDs from the resolution manifest's authoritative Up and Down outcome roles
terminal direction independently from both official-source BTC open/close prices and terminal Up/Down outcome prices
implementation.failure_action: Any non-finite input, decision mismatch, unreachable capture row, or inconsistent evaluation result aborts scoring as an integrity error.

validation.clippy: PASS: all targets with warnings denied after allowing two documented pre-existing unrelated lints

deployment_boundary.next_step: Continue outcome-blind collection to exactly 750 admissible conditions, then build and hash-pin a separate schema-6 Linux scorer from the pinned harness and scorer sources before the single authorized scoring pass.
